## FileValue interface

A file or binary content returned by an operation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface FileValue
```

## Remarks

`path`<!-- -->, when present, is the original path on the executing Mac. Content without a path (binary data held by the app) is still fetchable. Fetching is authorized: it requires the invocation's credential and is limited to content an authorized operation returned.
